verificationTiming: The swap was read earlier in this verification session; verifiedAt records completion of the subsequent approval read, whose timestamp was captured directly. No exact earlier swap-read timestamp was captured.

checks: Each receipt transaction hash and sender matched its transaction.
Each receipt block hash matched its transaction and eth_getBlockByNumber result.
The approval transaction targeted canonical USDG and approved the same router targeted by the swap.
verification.authority: Public RPC observations; not light-client verification or an L1-finality claim.

limits: These are two individual successful application transactions, not a complete rebalance-cycle fee record.
Repricing their measured gas with current ETH/USD and gas quotes is approximate; it is not eth_estimateGas for a proposed transaction.
The original approvals, route, amount, token state and calldata can differ from a future transaction.
Robinhood bundles L2 execution and L1 data charges into charged gas; gasUsedForL1 must not be added again.
Both sampled receipts reported gasUsedForL1 equal to zero; this does not establish that future L1 data charges will be zero.
No private keys, credentials or signed raw transactions were read or retained in this evidence.
